source_summary: Encrypted session data from cookies via pickle serialization, with space padding added during encryption
guard_summary: No padding validation or integrity checking; rstrip() removes all trailing whitespace including padding
risk_pattern: AES decryption followed by rstrip() removes all trailing whitespace, potentially corrupting decrypted plaintext if original data contained trailing spaces or if padding removal is incorrect
context_summary: Session cookie decryption path: base64 decode -> AES decrypt -> rstrip() -> pickle deserialize. Encryption pads with spaces to 16-byte blocks, decryption strips all trailing spaces.

Whether the AES mode used requires specific padding validation
Whether other crypto implementations (pycryptopp, JCE) handle padding differently
